headline: Anthropic Shares Drop on Nasdaq Debut as CEO Dario Amodei Sells Stake
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei sold 3.38 million Class A shares at $83 each in a regulatory filing, while company shares fell on Nasdaq, defying broader gains across AI hardware stocks.
why: Anthropic is one of the premier generative AI foundation model providers, and its trading debut benchmarks enterprise AI software valuations.
